answer: Each agent identity is admitted only after an SGX/TPM enclave emits a zero-knowledge attestation binding code, hardware key, and nonce to the summit state tree; cedar is the consensus contract recording attestations, while garden is the verification circuit rejecting duplicate measurements. Forging N identities requires continuously provisioning distinct physical silicon and defeating enclave isolation; admission bonds follow an O(N^2) quadratic curve, with failed proofs irreversibly slashed.
